message.content:
As a UI/UX design analyst, here is an extreme technical breakdown of the **Goahead Incident Management Dashboard**. This analysis is structured to provide the exact specifications needed for a pixel-perfect code recreation.

---

### 1. Overall Layout Structure
The interface follows a classic **SaaS Application Shell** (Sidebar + Main Content) with a nested "Card-within-Card" layout.

*   **Outer Container:** A browser window chrome (macOS style: red/yellow/green dots, address bar showing `https://goahead.com/incident`).
*   **Application Shell:** 
    *   **Left Sidebar:** Fixed width (~260px), dark theme, scrollable.
    *   **Main Content Area:** Light gray background (`#F9FAFB`), taking up remaining width, with internal padding (~24px).
*   **Content Hierarchy:**
    *   **Header Section:** Incident title, status pipeline, and action toolbar.
    *   **Body Grid:** A 2-column CSS Grid or Flexbox layout.
        *   **Left Column (Primary):** ~65% width. Contains the progress bar and a large "Task/Checklist" card.
        *   **Right Column (Secondary):** ~35% width. Contains metadata cards (Assignees, Links, Timestamps).

### 2. Visible UI Components

#### **A. Sidebar Navigation**
*   **Brand Header:** Logo icon (Circle with 'G') + Text "Goahead" + Chevron down icon.
*   **Navigation Items (Vertical List):**
    *   **Home:** Icon (House).
    *   **Incidents:** Icon (Bell/Alert). **Active State** (White background pill shape, black text).
    *   **Alerts:** Icon (Notification).
    *   **On-call:** Icon (Phone/Calendar).
    *   **Status pages:** Icon (Globe/Grid).
    *   **Post-incident:** Icon (Clipboard/List).
    *   **Insight:** Icon (Bar chart).
    *   **Catalog:** Accordion menu (expanded).
        *   Sub-items: People, Companies, Users, Workspaces.
    *   **List:** Accordion menu (expanded).
        *   Sub-items: Study With Ra... (Icon: Sparkles), Product-led Growth Targets (Icon: Rocket).
*   **Footer:** "Light Mode" toggle switch (Toggle is OFF/Dark mode active).

#### **B. Main Content - Header**
*   **Incident Badge:** Red square icon with white document symbol. Label "Incidents".
*   **Title:** `PTR – 96 Error after payment page` (H1 size, bold).
*   **Top Right Actions:**
    *   **Subscribe Button:** Icon (Wifi/RSS) + Text "Subscribers". Border only.
    *   **Kebab Menu:** Three vertical dots.

#### **C. Status Pipeline (Workflow Stepper)**
A horizontal sequence of stages indicating incident lifecycle:
1.  ✅ **Investigating** (Green checkmark)
2.  ➡️ **Fixing** (Blue arrow/right chevron)
3.  ✅ **Monitoring** (Green checkmark)
4.  📝 **Documenting** (Yellow pencil icon) — *Current Active Step*
5.  ➡️ **Reviewing** (Gray arrow)
6.  ⭕ **Closed** (Gray circle)

#### **D. Toolbar / Filter Bar**
*   **Primary Action Button:** Black background, white text "**Post Incidents**".
*   **Secondary Tabs/Toggles (Gray text, inactive look):** Updates, Timeline, Actions, Follow-up.
*   **Right Side Tools:**
    *   **Filter Button:** Funnel icon + "Filter".
    *   **Sort Button:** Arrows icon + "Sort".

#### **E. Progress Component**
*   **Label:** "0% Complete" (Bold, small text).
*   **Track:** Light gray background bar.
*   **Fill:** None visible (0%).

#### **F. The Main Task Card (Left Column)**
This is a complex component resembling a "Todo list" or "Playbook runner".
*   **Header:** "Review the incident timeline" (H2).
*   **Meta Tag:** "Due in 1d" inside a light gray pill badge with a clock icon.
*   **Body Layout:** Split into two vertical sections.
    *   **Left Rail (Checklist):** Narrow column with checkboxes.
        *   **Section Header:** "DOCUMENTING" (Uppercase, tiny, gray, tracking-wide).
        *   **Items:**
            *   [ ] Review the incident timeline (**Active/Bold**)
            *   [ ] Create the post-mortem
            *   [ ] Schedule the debrief
            *   [ ] Set timestamps
        *   **Section Header:** "REVIEWING"
        *   **Items:**
            *   [ ] Mark post-mortem as complete
            *   [ ] Share the post-mortem
            *   [ ] Review follow-ups
    *   **Right Rail (Content):** Wide column containing details for the active item.
        *   **Description Paragraph:** "The process of evaluating..." (Standard body text, line-height ~1.5).
        *   **Steps List:** Ordered list `<ol>`:
            1.  Gather Incident Data
            2.  Identify the Event Chronology
            ... (through 9. Implement and Follow-Up)
*   **Card Footer (Sticky/Absolute bottom of card):**
    *   **Skip Button:** White background, gray border, "X" icon + "Skip this step".
    *   **Complete Button:** **Green background**, white text, Checkmark icon + "**Mark as complete**".

#### **G. Metadata Sidebar (Right Column)**
Stacked informational blocks.

1.  **People Block:**
    *   **Incident Lead:** Avatar (Circle, dark hair) + Name "**Sam Arthur**".
    *   **Reporter:** Avatar (Circle, beard) + Name "**Ahmad Affif**".
    *   **Active Participant:** Group avatar (3 faces) + "**3+ People**".
2.  **Links Block:**
    *   **View Slack Channel:** Slack logo (Colorful) + Link text.
    *   **View Figma Design:** Figma logo (Colorful) + Link text.
3.  **Process Block (Post Mortem):**
    *   Icon (Clipboard) + "**Add post-mortem**" (Gray text, clickable).
4.  **Process Block (Debrief):**
    *   Icon (Clipboard) + "**Add debrief**" (Gray text, clickable).
5.  **Calls Block:**
    *   Label "Calls" + Info icon (i).
    *   Plus (+) icon on right to add.
6.  **Timestamps Block:**
    *   **Label:** "Timestamps" (Bold).
    *   **Row 1:** "Impact started at" | Value: **10/27/24, 10:07 AM** (Right aligned, monospace-ish).
    *   **Row 2:** "Declare at" | Value: **10/30/24, 16:49 AM** (Note: 16:49 is likely PM, but rendered as AM in UI).

---

### 3. Color Scheme (Dark Theme & Accents)

| Element | Color Code (Approximate Hex) | Usage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Sidebar BG** | `#1F2937` (Gray-800) or `#111827` (Gray-900) | Main navigation background |
| **Sidebar Text** | `#9CA3AF` (Gray-400) | Inactive nav items |
| **Sidebar Active BG** | `#FFFFFF` (White) | Selected "Incidents" item |
| **Sidebar Active Text** | `#000000` (Black) | Selected item text |
| **Main BG** | `#F3F4F6` (Gray-100) | Page background |
| **Card BG** | `#FFFFFF` (White) | All content containers |
| **Primary Text** | `#111827` (Gray-900) | Headings, body text |
| **Secondary Text** | `#6B7280` (Gray-500) | Labels, descriptions |
| **Accent Green** | `#10B981` (Emerald-500) | "Mark as complete", Checkmarks, Success states |
| **Accent Blue** | `#3B82F6` (Blue-500) | Arrows in pipeline, Links |
| **Accent Yellow** | `#F59E0B` (Amber-500) | Pencil icon (Documenting stage) |
| **Accent Red** | `#EF4444` (Red-500) | Incident icon badge |
| **Border Color** | `#E5E7EB` (Gray-200) | Dividers, card borders, input fields |

---

### 4. Typography Patterns

*   **Font Family:** Inter (or similar geometric sans-serif like SF Pro, Roboto).
*   **Hierarchy:**
    *   **H1 (Incident Title):** 20px–24px, Font-weight: 600 (Semibold).
    *   **H2 (Card Title):** 18px, Font-weight: 600.
    *   **H3 (Section Labels):** 11px–12px, Uppercase, Letter-spacing: 0.05em, Color: Gray-500.
    *   **Body Text:** 14px, Line-height: 1.5, Color: Gray-700.
    *   **Small/Meta:** 12px–13px, Color: Gray-500.
    *   **Monospace/Data:** 13px, Font-family: System monospace (for dates/times).

---

### 5. Data Values (Exact Transcription)

**Table: Task Checklist (Documenting Phase)**
| Status | Task Name |
| :--- | :--- |
| ☐ | Review the incident timeline |
| ☐ | Create the post-mortem |
| ☐ | Schedule the debrief |
| ☐ | Set timestamps |

**Table: Task Checklist (Reviewing Phase)**
| Status | Task Name |
| :--- | :--- |
| ☐ | Mark post-mortem as complete |
| ☐ | Share the post-mortem |
| ☐ | Review follow-ups |

**Table: Incident Metadata**
| Field | Value |
| :--- | :--- |
| Incident Lead | Sam Arthur |
| Reporter | Ahmad Affif |
| Active Participants | 3+ People |
| Impact Started | 10/27/24, 10:07 AM |
| Declared At | 10/30/24, 16:49 AM |

**Ordered List (Review Steps):**
1. Gather Incident Data
2. Identify the Event Chronology
3. Identify Actors and Roles
4. Analyze Each Stage
5. Look for Patterns or Trends
6. Document Findings
7. Discuss with the Team
8. Identify Improvements
9. Implement and Follow-Up

---

### 6. Chart Types and Data
*   **No traditional charts** (bar/line/pie) are present in this view.
*   **Progress Bar:** Linear horizontal bar. Current value: **0%**. Fill color would be Green (`#10B981`) when >0%.

---

### 7. Status Indicators

| Indicator | Visual | Meaning |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Complete** | ✅ Green Circle Check | Stage finished successfully |
| **In Progress** | 📝 Yellow Pencil / Blue Arrow | Current active stage |
| **Pending** | ➡️ Gray/Blue Arrow | Future stage not started |
| **Closed** | ⭕ Gray Circle | Final state (inactive) |
| **Due Soon** | 🕒 Clock Icon + "Due in 1d" | Urgency indicator on task |
| **Active Nav** | White Pill Background | Current page location |

---

### 8. Spacing and Padding Patterns

*   **Grid Gap:** ~24px between Left and Right columns.
*   **Card Padding:** ~24px internal padding on all sides for main cards.
*   **Sidebar Item Padding:** ~8px vertical, ~12px horizontal.
*   **Element Spacing:**
    *   Between checklist items: ~12px–16px.
    *   Between metadata rows: ~16px.
    *   Between header elements (Title/Badge): ~12px.
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Buttons/Pills: **6px–8px** (Rounded).
    *   Cards: **8px–12px** (Large radius).
    *   Avatars: **50%** (Circle).
    *   Checkboxes: **4px** (Slight rounding).

---

### 9. Form Elements

*   **Checkboxes:** Standard unchecked state (Square, 2px border, gray). No checked boxes are visible in the screenshot (all tasks pending).
*   **Toggle Switch:** Located in sidebar footer. iOS-style toggle. Currently set to **Left (Off)** position, indicating Dark Mode is active.
*   **Buttons:**
    *   **Primary (Solid):** Black ("Post Incidents"), Green ("Mark as complete"). Padding X: 16px, Y: 8px.
    *   **Secondary (Ghost/Outline):** "Subscribers", "Filter", "Sort", "Skip this step". Border: 1px solid Gray-200/300.

---

### 10. Modal/Overlay Elements
*   **None visible.** The interface is in a standard "view" state without any open modals, popovers, or toast notifications.

---

### Summary for Implementation
To recreate this, use a **Flex row** for the shell (Sidebar + Main). Inside Main, use a **CSS Grid** with columns `2fr 1fr`. The left grid cell contains the **Progress Header** followed by the **Task Card** (which itself uses Flex row for the split-pane checklist/detail view). The right grid cell contains a **Stack (Flex col)** of smaller metadata cards. Pay close attention to the **z-index layering** of the "Mark as complete" button—it appears pinned to the bottom of the task card content area.
